David Sterling
Financial Analyst
New York, NY | david.sterling@email.com | +1 555-012-7788 | linkedin.com/in/davidsterling-finance

SUMMARY
Detail-oriented Financial Analyst with 4 years of experience in corporate FP&A, financial modeling, budgeting, and variance analysis. Skilled in Excel, SQL, and Power BI with a proven track record of identifying $1.2M+ in cost savings and improving forecast accuracy.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Financial Analyst | Vertex Financial Group | New York, NY | 2021 - Present
- Built dynamic financial models in Excel and SQL to evaluate annual $45M operating budgets and multi-year revenue projections.
- Automated monthly FP&A reporting dashboards using Power BI and SQL, saving 20 hours of manual data entry per month.
- Conducted variance analysis against quarterly forecasts, identifying operational inefficiencies that led to $1.2M in annual cost savings.
- Prepared executive financial statement packages and revenue analysis decks for C-suite decision-making.

Junior Financial Analyst | Capital Partners LLC | New York, NY | 2019 - 2021
- Performed financial modeling, discounted cash flow (DCF) valuation, and scenario analysis for prospective investments.
- Improved financial forecasting accuracy from 82% to 94% by integrating historical sales data and trend indicators.
- Managed quarterly expense reconciliation across 8 business departments.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance | New York University (NYU Stern) | 2015 - 2019
- Cum Laude, Finance Society Vice President

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Financial Analysis: Financial Modeling, Forecasting, Budgeting, Variance Analysis, FP&A, Financial Statements, Revenue Analysis
- Tools & Software: Advanced Excel (VBA, Macros, PivotTables), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, SAP ERP, Bloomberg Terminal
jobDescriptionText: Seeking a Financial Analyst with 3-5 years experience in Financial Modeling, FP&A, Forecasting, Budgeting, and Variance Analysis. Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Financial Statements required.
